rounds.text: Primo Chemicals trades at a premium P/E of 31.59x, significantly higher than the sector benchmark of 21.06x, despite delivering poor returns on capital [E6, E10]. Recent performance trends are concerning, as compounded sales growth has turned negative at -3% over the trailing twelve months, while compounded profit growth has plummeted by 17% [E16, E19]. Furthermore, the company’s liquidity position is precarious, evidenced by a current ratio of 0.61x, indicating that current liabilities exceed current assets [E36]. Investors are also facing a lack of capital return, as the dividend yield is 0.00% and the stock has suffered a 14% decline in share price over the last year [E4, E23]. Conceded: the company has successfully reduced its borrowings from Rs 169 Cr to Rs 131 Cr and maintains strong cash conversion [E31, E37].
